newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed after thin and range-bound trade on Thursday, as private investors were generally sidelined and looking for direction, the traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 0.6 yen firmer. Benchmark May was 0.1 yen firmer at 142.0 yen.

"Private investors have been shifting money to more volatile commodity futures such as cotton futures," one trader said. "Prices are likely to be trapped within tight ranges unless fresh factors emerge," the trader said.
